name: Salyut-4
about: Salyut-4 (1974-104A), a station core, launched 1974 Dec 26. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (D).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1975 Jan 26), held fixed
